# Aaron Wetzler

Academic homepage for Aaron Wetzler, CTO of an early-stage company. Previously Incubation and ML Lead at Apple and CTO of Camerai (acquired). Research areas include computer vision, machine learning, gesture recognition, and numerical geometry.

## Main resources

- Homepage: `https://twerdster.github.io/`
- Research, code, and data: `https://twerdster.github.io/#software`
- Machine-readable index: `https://twerdster.github.io/data/site-content.json`
- Tea source code: `https://github.com/twerdster/tea`
- HandNet dataset page: `https://twerdster.github.io/HandNet/`
- HandNet embedded 20-sample viewer: `https://twerdster.github.io/HandNet/#explorer`
- HandNet standalone 20-sample viewer: `https://twerdster.github.io/HandNet/explorer/`
- HandNet complete public dataset: `https://huggingface.co/datasets/twerdster/HandNet`
- HandNet seven source archives: `https://huggingface.co/datasets/twerdster/HandNet/tree/main/archives`
- HandNet extended 96-sample research Space: `https://huggingface.co/spaces/twerdster/HandNet-Explorer`
- HandNet derived 96-row Parquet preview: `https://huggingface.co/datasets/twerdster/HandNet/resolve/main/preview/samples.parquet`
- HandNet data license: `https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/`

The publication list includes the 2026 NeurIPS Robot Learning Workshop paper on robot-free demonstrations and the 2020 CoBe paper on coded beacons. Publication PDFs, BibTeX files, posters, slides, videos, patent records, and dataset links are listed directly on the homepage and in `data/site-content.json`.

HandNet is publicly available without a gate on Hugging Face. The complete release contains 214,971 original frames (202,198 train, 10,000 test, 2,773 validation) and seven unchanged distribution archives, totaling 25,475,576,842 bytes. Transformed variants reuse original examples. The data is licensed under CC BY 4.0, permitting academic and commercial reuse with attribution, a license link and an indication of changes. Credit Aaron Wetzler, Ron Slossberg and Ron Kimmel and cite their BMVC 2015 paper. The historical MATLAB repository retains its separate original terms.

The HandNet project page embeds a self-contained 20-sample viewer served by this GitHub Pages repository. Its scripts, vendored dependencies and sample assets use relative URLs; it does not depend on a Hugging Face iframe or CDN. The separate Hugging Face research Space and Parquet preview contain 96 derived visualization rows, not the full dataset. Display images and calibrated point clouds illustrate measured annotations; they do not constitute learned detector inference or a full anatomical hand-joint skeleton.

The HandNet page also retains the paper, poster, presentation, supplementary archive and citation links. The academic archive retains 12 publications, 21 student projects, the undergraduate thesis, and six demonstration video links. The homepage, archive and HandNet project page share typography, navigation and theme.
